issue_request: FHIR-11210 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 Composition tracker asking why the valueset-doc-typecodes page had no generated expansion and why a link near the top appeared to go to the main HL7 webpage.
initial_application: No commit explicitly names FHIR-11210. The same-era source history includes 2ea2f88f92ad35028521ebd3e595f50daa73990e, which changed the doc-typecodes publisher contact telecom system from other to url, while later publisher/terminology behavior now renders the large LOINC expansion from the compose definition.
additional_context: Composition is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/composition/valueset-doc-typecodes.xml defines http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/doc-typecodes as LOINC concepts where SCALE_TYP = LP32888-7 (Doc). The current rendered CI page has an Expansion section generated from tx.fhir.org, warns that the value set has more than 1000 codes, and lists LOINC codes. The conformance JSON source intentionally does not include a static inline expansion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the authoritative ValueSet definition is in scope and correct, and the reported generated-page expansion problem is no longer present.
